description.value:
Duration constant

Choose one Minor mutation from the Bloom Table (or another Minor mutation your GM allows) and a Slot to carry it in. This mutation is with you from birth, not grafted — it never counts against your Strain, and it cannot be removed by ordinary downtime surgery, only by whatever process would remove a Scar's Slot outright.

cinderfall.incomplete: The ChoiceSet+GrantItem shape (P2) is real and buildable in the abstract, but there's nothing to choose *from* in Foundry-schema terms — no Bloom Table of selectable mutation items exists as item:tag:-filterable records, and "never counts against Strain" has no resource to exempt it from. The Strain/Bloom-Table/mutation-Slot economy has no SpecialResource or other Foundry-schema representation anywhere in the corpus (confirmed via grep -rli '"strain"' site/data/cards/classes/, no hits, and grep -rl '"key": "SpecialResource"' site/data/cards/, one unrelated hit in fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json).
